text:
claire: Heads up — onboarding the 2-bit quant build for redwood-min into the eval harness is making the eval-runner queue explode and CI flaky. Seen repeated shard reschedule/retry loops.

sam: can you paste the logs? is this failing on worker OOM or watchdog restarts?

claire: snippet from eval-runner.log:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:34Z ERROR shard=42 dispatch: worker exited: signal 9
2026-03-15T18:12:34Z WARN shard=42 retrying assignment (attempt=1)
2026-03-15T18:12:34Z INFO shard=42 rescheduled -> queue length=137
```

daniel: looks like the worker exits right when the quant kernels hit a bad codepath. We had the batcher v2 change last week that reduced per-request memory headroom — quant + long sequences can push the process past the limit and the dispatcher just loops retrying.

infra-bot: :rotating_light: alert: worker-restarts for eval-runner service increased to 42 in the last 5m. See incident #INC-2026-042.

morgan: can we pin the model to float16 or use a fallback quant profile to confirm it's quant-specific? quick A/B will rule that out.

claire: reproducer steps I used on staging: `./scripts/eval_run --model redwood-min-2q --shards 4 --batch 1 --seq 2048` — run on a dedicated small pool. Getting the same rapid reschedule.

sam: two quick mitigation ideas: 1) short-term: increase worker backoff and add jitter so dispatch doesn't hammer the queue, 2) medium: add a backpressure circuit-breaker that pauses assignment to overloaded shards. I'm happy to open the PR. :+1:

daniel: FYI I already started a branch that adds exponential backoff + randomized jitter to the shard allocator (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/4582). Tests pass locally but CI kept timing out because of a flaky integration test — might not have merged.

morgan: we should also add a metric for per-shard retry counts and a derived alert (retry_rate > X for Ym). Right now dashboards only show queue length which is reactive.

claire: agreed. and we need a perf test that runs quant models with long seq to catch this in CI — current unit tests mock the runtime and miss the kernel memory effects.

sam: I can add the circuit-breaker + backoff PR today. will also add a small integ that runs a reduced-traffic quant model in a canary pool. cc @daniel for review.

daniel: I'll rebase PR #4582 and try to fix the integ flake (likely timing). if we can get that merged we should throttle retries by default.

infra-bot: scheduled job started: eval-canary/redwood-min-2q @ staging (job id 7761).

claire: thanks — assigning ownership: sam to implement circuit-breaker/backoff, daniel to finish PR and CI fixes, morgan to add dashboard telemetry. goal: mitigate in staging within 24h and run a controlled canary before rolling to prod. :eyes:

sam: ack. starting now.

morgan: will draft the new grafana panel and alert rule, posting link when ready.

claire: update in-thread once canary stabilizes, otherwise we'll rollback the quant model rollout.
